questions.q: Core: 0 to 12 m/s in 4 s, constant 12 m/s for 10 s, then to rest in 6 s. Find (a) the first acceleration (b) the total distance (c) the average speed
Extend : A train accelerates uniformly from rest for T seconds to 25 m/s, travels at 25 m/s for 40 s, then decelerates uniformly to rest in 10 s. The total distance is 1500 m. Find T.
Stretch: A distance-time graph is curved. Explain how to estimate the speed at one moment.
questions.a: Draw a tangent at that point and find its gradient

questions.q: A train accelerates from 4 m/s to 16 m/s in 6 s. Find the acceleration and the distance.
questions.model: Acceleration = change in speed ÷ time = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 m/s². Distance = area of trapezium = ½ × (4 + 16) × 6 = 60 m.
